topic: POC location scope and sensor distribution
summary_markdown:
The team discussed potential cities for a Proof of Concept (POC) with Accurat. It was suggested that while Brussels is possible, regulatory concerns might make it difficult, and Leuven was identified as a strong alternative city.

Regarding the scope, the POC needs to define the universe for sensor placement (e.g., Street, Shopping Mall, Station). A proposal was made to focus on one MALL location and all other City (Street) locations. The team also addressed a request for a draft proposal detailing the distribution of 900 sensors across the project area, which [p4] clarified is required by the Ops team for client submission.
decisions: Leuven was identified as a strong candidate city for the POC.
The POC scope should ideally include one MALL location and all other City (Street) locations.
action_items: [p2] to send information regarding potential cities to get a general idea, pending confirmation from Accurat.
